# Transport Dept yearly summary

This summary lists the main money decisions of the department for the year, written for new staff who want to know where the funds go. The fleet allocation was set as follows.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| New electric buses (24 units at 0.85 each) | 20.4 |
| Maintenance | 11.6 |
| Charging infrastructure | 6.0 |
| **Total fleet budget** | **38.0** |

Other items such as lanes and stops are planned by the corridor teams and are not part of this table.
